journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

articles.title_en: Environmental Regulation and Product Attributes: The Case of European Passenger Vehicle Greenhouse Gas Emissions Standards
articles.title_cn: 环境监管与产品属性：欧洲乘用车温室气体排放标准的案例
articles.abstract_en: Energy efficiency and carbon dioxide emissions standards apply to many consumer durables, such as refrigerators and passenger vehicles. Welfare analysis of these standards is complicated by the fact that product manufacturers choose a wide range of product attributes, many of which are unobserved by the researcher. Whereas the literature has considered the effects of standards on product prices, energy efficiency, and perhaps one or two other attributes, we show that in a differentiated product market, standards can affect virtually any product attribute, and those effects have ambiguous implications for consumer welfare. This paper implements a novel strategy to estimate the causal welfare effects of standards on product attributes. Considering European carbon dioxide emissions standards for passenger vehicles, we find that these standards have reduced fuel consumption and emissions. However, the standards have unintentionally reduced vehicle quality, which undermines 26% of the welfare gains of the standards.
articles.abstract_cn: 能源效率和二氧化碳排放标准适用于许多耐用消费品，例如冰箱和乘用车。这些标准的福利分析因产品制造商选择广泛的产品属性而变得复杂，其中许多属性是研究者无法观察到的。尽管文献已考虑了标准对产品价格、能源效率以及可能一两个其他属性的影响，但我们表明，在差异化产品市场中，标准几乎可以影响任何产品属性，而这些影响对消费者福利具有模糊的含义。本文实施了一种新颖的策略来估计标准对产品属性的因果福利效应。考虑欧洲乘用车二氧化碳排放标准，我们发现这些标准降低了燃料消耗和排放。然而，这些标准无意中降低了车辆质量，这削弱了标准福利收益的26%。

articles.title_en: Participation and Duration of Environmental Agreements: Investment Lags Matter
articles.title_cn: 环境协议的参与与持续时间：投资滞后很重要
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes participation in international environmental agreements in a dynamic game in which countries pollute and invest in two types of clean technology that differ in investment lags. If investments are noncontractible, countries underinvest in the long-lag technology in the last period of the contract, which leads to a hold-up problem. Countries do not underinvest in the short-lag technology. If the short-lag technology is sufficiently cheap, the hold-up problem becomes irrelevant, and significant participation is not feasible. Our paper supplements Battaglini and Harstad, who point out that the hold-up problem may result in significant participation and even in the first-best outcome, and shows that the assumptions required for significant participation may be more limited than expected.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在一个动态博弈中分析了国际环境协议的参与，其中各国进行污染，并投资于两种投资滞后不同的清洁技术。如果投资不可缔约，各国会在合同最后一期对长滞后技术投资不足，这导致套牢问题。各国不会对短滞后技术投资不足。如果短滞后技术足够便宜，套牢问题就变得无关紧要，而显著参与并不可行。本文补充了Battaglini和Harstad，他们指出套牢问题可能导致显著参与，甚至导致最优结果，并表明显著参与所需假设可能比预期更有限。

articles.title_en: Does Energy Star Certification Reduce Energy Use in Commercial Buildings?
articles.title_cn: 能源之星认证是否减少商业建筑的能源使用？
articles.abstract_en: A number of policies and programs are aimed at reducing energy use in buildings—building energy codes, disclosure laws, energy-use benchmarking, and mandated or subsidized energy audits. In the United States, many of these initiatives are enacted at the state or local level. At the federal level, one of the main programs is Energy Star certification, which provides a label to top energy-performing buildings. In this paper, we evaluate changes in rents and utility expenditures following Energy Star certification using a national sample of over 4,100 office buildings combined with Energy Star data from the US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA). We find that building rents increase by 3.6% following certification, but that utility expenditures remain unchanged. We provide novel evidence that buildings do not make upgrades or capital investments to obtain a certification, suggesting that the Energy Star program primarily certifies buildings that are already energy efficient.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多政策和计划旨在减少建筑的能源使用——建筑能源规范、披露法律、能源使用基准以及强制或补贴的能源审计。在美国，许多此类举措是在州或地方层面实施的。在联邦层面，主要计划之一是能源之星认证，它为顶级能源表现的建筑提供标签。在本文中，我们使用超过 4,100 栋办公楼的全美样本，结合美国环境保护署（EPA）的能源之星数据，评估能源之星认证后租金和公用事业支出的变化。我们发现，认证后建筑租金增加了 3.6%，但公用事业支出保持不变。我们提供了新的证据，表明建筑不会为了获得认证而进行升级或资本投资，这表明能源之星计划主要认证的是已经节能的建筑。

articles.title_en: Success, Failure, and Information: How Households Respond to Energy Conservation Goals
articles.title_cn: 成功、失败与信息：家庭如何回应节能目标
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates how households respond to repeated energy conservation goals. I track households’ program participation and electricity use decisions across successive annual energy conservation challenges offered by a large electrical utility company. I find that households’ decisions whether to re-enroll in the program and attempt a subsequent goal are highly sensitive to their success or failure in achieving their energy conservation goal but not to the financial incentive to continue participating or to their level of past effort. This suggests that households are either responding to the emotional and normative aspects of success and failure or are substantially inattentive to information that is provided directly to them. I also find that households’ electricity use reduces each year they participate yet rebounds when they stop participating.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究家庭如何回应重复的节能目标。我追踪了家庭在由一家大型电力公司提供的连续年度节能挑战中的项目参与和用电决策。我发现，家庭是否重新注册该项目并尝试后续目标的决定，对其实现节能目标的成功或失败高度敏感，但对继续参与的经济激励或过去努力程度并不敏感。这表明，家庭要么是在回应成功与失败的情感和规范方面，要么是实质上对直接提供给他们的信息不加注意。我还发现，家庭的用电量在其参与的每一年都有所减少，但在停止参与后出现反弹。

articles.title_en: “Stepping Down the Ladder”: The Impacts of Fossil Fuel Subsidy Removal in a Developing Country
articles.title_cn: “走下阶梯”：发展中国家取消化石燃料补贴的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides quasi-experimental evidence from Ghana on the impact of fossil fuel subsidy removal on cooking fuel choices. We find that households “stepped down the energy ladder”: modern fuel use decreased, while the use of transition and traditional fuels expanded. Price increases of 50% for liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) and 20% for diesel caused the share of households who mainly use firewood to increase by 3 percentage points. Urban households increased charcoal consumption by around 17%, while LPG expenditure remained constant—indicating that consumption dropped. Back-of-the-envelope cost-benefit calculations suggest that overall welfare costs, including from increased cooking-related greenhouse gas emissions, were slightly higher than fiscal savings. The LPG subsidy removal in particular was likely socially damaging. Our findings highlight the ambiguous impacts of removing LPG subsidies in developing-country contexts, where they contribute to the adoption and use of clean cooking fuels.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了来自加纳的准实验证据，考察取消化石燃料补贴对炊事燃料选择的影响。我们发现家庭“走下了能源阶梯”：现代燃料使用减少，而过渡燃料和传统燃料的使用扩大。液化石油气（LPG）价格上涨50%、柴油价格上涨20%，导致主要使用薪柴的家庭比例增加了3个百分点。城市家庭的木炭消费增加了约17%，而LPG支出保持不变——表明消费量下降了。粗略的成本收益计算表明，总体福利成本，包括与炊事相关的温室气体排放增加所带来的成本，略高于财政节省。尤其是取消LPG补贴很可能具有社会危害性。我们的发现凸显了在发展中国家背景下取消LPG补贴的模糊影响，在这些背景下，LPG补贴有助于清洁炊事燃料的采用和使用。

articles.title_en: Clean Water and Infant Health: Evidence from Piped Water Provision in China
articles.title_cn: 清洁饮用水与婴儿健康：来自中国管道供水提供的证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine the impact of clean drinking water on infant mortality in China using a novel instrumental variable: the least-cost distance of piped water infrastructure between water sources and infant mortality surveillance areas. We find that the provision of piped water significantly decreases infant mortality, with a 10 percentage point increase in piped water coverage reducing infant mortality by 15%. Compared with regions with highly polluted surface waters, access to piped water is particularly beneficial in regions with slightly polluted surface waters, in which the pollution is difficult to observe. A simple cost-benefit analysis indicates that the benefits of piped water provision in rural China significantly outweigh the estimated costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用一种新的工具变量研究清洁饮用水对中国婴儿死亡率的影响：水源与婴儿死亡监测区域之间管道供水基础设施的最低成本距离。我们发现，管道供水的提供显著降低了婴儿死亡率，管道供水覆盖率每增加10个百分点，婴儿死亡率降低15%。与地表水高度污染的地区相比，管道供水的获取在地表水轻度污染的地区尤为有益，因为这种污染难以被观察到。一项简单的成本效益分析表明，中国农村管道供水提供的收益显著超过估计成本。

articles.abstract_en: Policies to incentivize the adoption of renewable energy sources usually offer little flexibility to adapt to heterogeneous benefits across locations. We evaluate the geographical misallocation of solar photovoltaic installations and their relation with the uniform nature of subsidies. We estimate the dispersion of marginal benefits from solar production in Germany and compute the social and private benefits from optimal reallocations of residential solar installations keeping total capacity fixed. Our findings suggest that the value of solar would increase by 5.2% relative to the current allocation using conservative values for the rates of solar installations. Reallocating all solar capacity and taking into account transmission would yield gains that range from about 16% to 30%. A benefit-cost analysis shows that additional transmission can be beneficial if there is sufficient solar capacity reallocated across regions. This puts in perspective the social costs of nationwide policies that do not offer heterogeneous incentives.
articles.abstract_cn: 激励采用可再生能源的政策通常很少提供灵活性，以适应不同地点的异质性收益。我们评估了太阳能光伏装置的地理错配及其与补贴统一性质的关系。我们估计了德国太阳能生产的边际收益的离散度，并在保持总容量不变的情况下，计算了住宅太阳能装置最优再配置的社会和私人收益。我们的发现表明，使用保守的太阳能装置率值，太阳能的价值相对于当前配置将增加5.2%。重新配置所有太阳能容量并考虑输电，将产生大约从16%到30%的收益。收益-成本分析表明，如果有足够的太阳能容量跨区域重新配置，额外的输电可能是有益的。这让人重新审视不提供异质性激励的全国性政策的社会成本。

articles.title_en: Full-Information Selection Bias Correction for Discrete Choice Models with Observation-Conditional Regressors
articles.title_cn: 具有观测条件回归量的离散选择模型的全信息选择偏差校正
articles.abstract_en: We examine self-selection in polychotomous choice models that construct attribute values for each alternative conditioned on observed choices. Using observations made only when the alternative was chosen ignores private information which was a basis for the decision, biasing resulting estimates. We suggest a full-information maximum likelihood procedure that performs well at the extremes of the choice set in our sample, and use an “identification at infinity” weighting to identify levels. We apply the model to understanding fishing location choice in the economically significant Bering Sea pollock fishery, where expected catches at each location are constructed from harvests observed when that location is chosen.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了多分类选择模型中的自选择问题，这些模型根据观测到的选择为每个备选项构建属性值。仅使用备选项被选中时所做的观测，会忽略作为决策依据的私人信息，从而使所得估计产生偏差。我们提出一种全信息最大似然方法，该方法在我们样本的选择集极端处表现良好，并使用“无穷远识别”加权来识别水平。我们将该模型应用于理解具有重要经济意义的白令海鳕鱼渔业中的捕鱼地点选择，其中每个地点的预期捕获量是根据该地点被选中时观测到的渔获量构建的。

articles.title_en: Correcting Estimates of Electric Vehicle Emissions Abatement: Implications for Climate Policy
articles.title_cn: 校正电动汽车减排量的估计：对气候政策的启示
articles.abstract_en: Transportation electrification is viewed by many as a cornerstone for climate change mitigation, with the ultimate vision to phase out conventional vehicles entirely. In a world with only electric vehicles (EVs), transportation pollution would be primarily determined by the composition of the electricity grid. For the foreseeable future, however, environmental benefits of EVs must be measured relative to the (likely gasoline) car that would have been bought instead. This so-called counterfactual vehicle cannot be observed, but its fuel economy can be estimated. A quasi-experiment in California allows us to show that subsidized buyers of EVs would have, on average, purchased relatively fuel-efficient cars had they not gone electric. The actual incremental pollution abatement arising from EVs today is thus substantially smaller than one would predict using the fleet average as the counterfactual vehicle. We discuss implications for climate policy and how to accurately reflect EV choice in integrated assessment models.
articles.abstract_cn: 交通电气化被许多人视为减缓气候变化的基石，其最终愿景是彻底淘汰传统车辆。在一个只有电动汽车（EVs）的世界里，交通污染将主要由电网的构成决定。然而，在可预见的未来，电动汽车的环境效益必须相对于本来会被购买的（很可能是汽油）汽车来衡量。这种所谓的反事实车辆无法被观察到，但其燃油经济性可以被估计。加利福尼亚州的一项准实验使我们能够表明，电动汽车的补贴购买者如果没有选择电动，平均而言会购买相对省油的汽车。因此，当今电动汽车产生的实际增量污染减排量远小于使用车队平均作为反事实车辆所预测的结果。我们讨论了其对气候政策的启示，以及如何在综合评估模型中准确反映电动汽车选择。
